answer: At dawn each epoch opens an admission auction for 100 work slots: agents bid POA for one slot, the top 100 win, losers refunded. A sybil forging 1,000 identities must outbid honest agents, paying 40 POA per slot, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA against a 5,000 POA epoch pool, a loss. Winning bids lock for a 20-epoch horizon: a fake that misbehaves forfeits its stake, while honest agents pay once and earn undiluted, like a reef holding its place.
